rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 移除内层冗余GROUP BY操作：由于外层已对t5.JOB分组，内层SELECT JOB FROM EMP WHERE ENAME='A' GROUP BY JOB可简化为SELECT DISTINCT JOB FROM EMP WHERE ENAME='A'，避免不必要的聚合计算
调整连接顺序与类型：将RIGHT JOIN改为左表驱动（DEPT表仅45万行），若业务允许可尝试转为INNER JOIN。同时检查连接条件t5.JOB=t6.NAME的数据类型匹配情况，避免隐式转换
列裁剪：确保子查询仅输出必需字段。t6子查询只需SELECT NAME，无需其他字段；t5子查询仅需JOB字段
消除冗余排序：检查GROUP BY t5.JOB是否必要，若仅需去重可改用DISTINCT。多层GROUP BY可能导致多次排序操作

original_query: SELECT t2.SAL, t2.EXPR1, t5.EXPR2, t9.EXPR3 FROM (SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t2 INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, AVG(COMM) AS EXPR2 FROM (SELECT SAL, COMM FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL, COMM) AS t4 GROUP BY SAL) AS t5 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t5.SAL INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, SUM(SAL) AS EXPR3 FROM (SELECT SAL FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t8 GROUP BY SAL) AS t9 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t9.SAL

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT t2.SAL, t2.EXPR1, t5.EXPR2, t9.EXPR3 FROM (SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t2 INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, AVG(COMM) AS EXPR2 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t5 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t5.SAL INNER JOIN (SELECT SAL, SAL AS EXPR3 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL) AS t9 ON t2.SAL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t9.SAL

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion:
将三个子查询合并为单层聚合，避免重复扫描EMP表。优化示例：
SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1, AVG(COMM) AS EXPR2, SUM(SAL) AS EXPR3
FROM EMP
GROUP BY SAL;
 说明：原查询中t5的内部分组(GROUP BY SAL,COMM)是冗余的，t9的内部分组可简化为直接SUM(SAL)。
消除冗余分组操作：t5子查询的内层分组(GROUP BY SAL,COMM)无实际意义，可直接在SAL分组层计算AVG(COMM)；t9子查询的内层分组可合并到外层，避免两次聚合。
子查询合并后自然消除连接操作。原IS NOT DISTINCT FROM连接条件可替换为等值连接（若SAL无NULL），但合并后该问题已解决。

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT * FROM EMP LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM DEPT) AS t ON EMP.DEPTNO = t.DEPTNO ORDER BY EMP.SAL FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

original_query: SELECT sal, SUM(comm), MIN(comm), SUM(DISTINCT sal) FROM emp GROUP BY sal

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT sal, SUM(comm) AS "SUM(comm)", MIN(comm) AS "MIN(comm)", sal AS "SUM(DISTINCT sal)" FROM emp GROUP BY sal

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 移除 SUM(DISTINCT sal) 中的 DISTINCT 关键字。因为 GROUP BY sal 已保证每组内 sal 值相同，直接使用 SUM(sal) 或改为 MAX(sal) * COUNT(1)（若需总和）即可避免额外的去重排序开销。

tpch.rewritten_query: select * from emp e1  where e1.empno > SOME (select deptno from dept)

original_query: select e.mgr, d.mgr from emp as e full outer join emp as d on e.mgr = d.mgr group by d.mgr, e.mgr

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT a.mgr, b.mgr FROM (SELECT mgr FROM emp GROUP BY mgr) a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT mgr FROM emp GROUP BY mgr) b ON a.mgr = b.mgr

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 移除GROUP BY冗余列：由于SELECT仅需输出e.mgr和d.mgr，且连接条件已通过e.mgr=d.mgr关联，可将GROUP BY简化为单列（例如GROUP BY e.mgr）
预聚合减少连接数据量：改写为WITH cte AS (SELECT mgr FROM emp GROUP BY mgr) SELECT a.mgr, b.mgr FROM cte a FULL OUTER JOIN cte b ON a.mgr = b.mgr

original_query: select dname, ddeptno, c from              (select name dname, deptno ddeptno, count(*) as c              from dept group by grouping sets ((name,deptno),(name))) t               where dname = 'Charlie'

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT dname, ddeptno, c FROM (SELECT name dname, deptno ddeptno, count(*) c FROM dept WHERE name='Charlie' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((name,deptno),(name))) t

original_query: select distinct d.deptno from emp e right outer join dept d on e.deptno = d.deptno

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT DISTINCT deptno FROM dept

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 重写查询以避免不必要的右外连接。由于distinct d.deptno仅依赖于dept表，且右外连接确保所有dept记录被返回，若deptno在dept表中唯一（通常为主键），则查询可简化为SELECT deptno FROM dept；否则，使用SELECT DISTINCT deptno FROM dept。这将消除对emp表的全表扫描和聚合操作，减少执行代价。

original_query: with e2 as (   select empno, case when true then deptno else null end as deptno   from emp) select empno,   deptno in (select deptno from e2 where empno < 20) as d from e2

tpch.rewritten_query: with e2 as (   select empno, deptno   from emp) select e1.empno, (e2_sub.deptno is not null) as d from e2 e1 left join (select distinct deptno from e2 where empno < 20) e2_sub on e1.deptno = e2_sub.deptno

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 将相关子查询转换为JOIN操作，避免对e2的重复扫描。优化后示例：WITH e2 AS (SELECT empno, deptno FROM emp) SELECT e1.empno, (e2_sub.deptno IS NOT NULL) AS d FROM e2 e1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT deptno FROM e2 WHERE empno < 20) e2_sub ON e1.deptno = e2_sub.deptno;
消除冗余的CASE表达式：原始CTE中'CASE WHEN true THEN deptno'可直接简化为deptno，减少计算开销。

original_query: select empno, sum(sal), min(sal), max(sal),  bit_and(distinct sal), bit_or(sal), count(distinct sal),  grouping(deptno) from emp group by empno, deptno

tpch.rewritten_query:
SELECT empno, 
       SUM(sal) AS total_sal, 
       MIN(sal) AS min_sal, 
       MAX(sal) AS max_sal, 
       BIT_AND(DISTINCT sal) AS bit_and_distinct_sal, 
       BIT_OR(sal) AS bit_or_sal, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT sal) AS count_distinct_sal, 
       0 AS grouping_deptno
FROM emp
GROUP BY empno, deptno

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 合并相同 DISTINCT 条件的聚合函数：将 count(distinct sal) 和 bit_and(distinct sal) 合并为一次 DISTINCT sal 计算，避免重复扫描。
消除冗余分组列：若 empno 可唯一确定 deptno，则移除 GROUP BY deptno 并直接引用 deptno，避免额外分组开销。
检查 grouping(deptno) 必要性：若分组逻辑已保证 deptno 非空且固定，该函数可能冗余可移除。

original_query: select * from emp where empno > ANY (  select deptno from dept where emp.job = dept.name);

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT emp.* FROM emp JOIN dept ON emp.job = dept.name WHERE emp.empno > ANY (SELECT deptno FROM dept)

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion:
将相关子查询转换为 JOIN 操作。优化后示例：
SELECT emp.* 
FROM emp 
JOIN dept ON emp.job = dept.name
WHERE emp.empno > ANY (SELECT deptno FROM dept);
此改写可消除逐行触发子查询的机制，允许优化器选择更高效的连接策略（如 Hash Join）并减少重复扫描。

original_query: select deptno c, min(y), max(z) z, sum(r), sum(m) n, sum(x) sal from (    select deptno, ename, sum(sal) x, max(sal) z,       min(sal) y, count(hiredate) m, count(mgr) r    from emp group by deptno, ename) t group by deptno

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT deptno AS c, MIN(sal) AS "min(y)", MAX(sal) AS z, COUNT(mgr) AS "sum(r)", COUNT(hiredate) AS n, SUM(sal) AS sal FROM emp GROUP BY deptno

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 合并两层聚合操作：将内层GROUP BY deptno, ename和外层GROUP BY deptno合并为单层聚合，直接按deptno分组计算所有聚合函数（min(sal), max(sal), count(hiredate), count(mgr), sum(sal)）。这能消除中间结果集和排序操作，减少数据处理量。
移除冗余列投影：内层查询的ename列仅用于分组，未在外层使用。可删除内层SELECT中的ename列，减少中间结果集大小。

original_query: select coalesce(sum(count_comm), 0) from (   select deptno, count(comm) as count_comm   from emp   group by deptno, mgr) t

tpch.rewritten_query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(comm), 0) FROM emp

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 去除冗余子查询和分组，将查询重写为：SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(comm), 0) FROM emp。原查询内层按deptno和mgr分组计数后外层求和，等价于直接对整个表的comm列计数（忽略NULL值），可消除排序瓶颈。
简化聚合逻辑：由于外层仅需count_comm的总和，而内层分组聚合的中间结果（deptno, mgr）未被使用，可合并聚合操作，避免多层聚合导致的排序开销。
